classification: Independent repeat of the completed native diagnostic battle, now with its first complete per-step position capture; not ordinary-match equivalence

comparison.explicit_host_tally_correction: Only the prior flags==3 tally is recomputed against unchanged events using original bit1 semantics. No native fields are normalized.
comparison.terminal_report_comparison: All native report fields match, including imported calls, guards, code hashes and budget PCs/registers. Source-closure metadata and host elapsed_seconds are separately reported.

limits: This is a second run of the original built-in Normal test using the same modeled platform, native random decks, test identities, test global1 and secondary context. It is not an ordinary or Android-device match.

The event/runner records match exactly, but they are selected observations, not every simulation-affecting field or complete ordered event stream. The new position stream has no older full-position baseline.
Frame0 and earlier400-tick component checks support read-only sampling; they do not prove universal hook noninterference, opaque CPU/VM equality or a complete reset mechanism.

Only three constructor-proven actor classes expose positions. Unknown classes and native position sentinels are retained without invented coordinates. No health, terrain geometry, game graphics or inferred seconds appear in the replay.
Native deployment markers use returned debit-call coordinates with directly observed accepted-command parent links. Delayed actor insertion and command cloning are not promoted to full causal proof.
Byte-identical ordinary gameplay, complete state/reset, measured self-play throughput and policy training remain unvalidated.
